app.title: Core Keeper Skin Maker
top.dropHint: Drag and drop an image here
preset.label: Preset
preset.randomTip: Combines colours and shapes on the spot to make a new character.
preset.recolorTip: Keeps the shapes you have and swaps the colours for the chosen preset's, so you can try a palette without losing your work.

status.fillOutsideFrame: That position belongs to no frame. The fill works inside a frame only.
import.title: Import settings
import.hint: These settings rebuild the sheet from the picture that was imported. Rebuilding loses any pixel edits you have made.
background.hint: Tolerance. Higher values treat a wider range as background. Photos usually need 30-60.
size.hint: Each frame is 26x26. The default 16x19 is the area the game's own character uses; art is anchored to the feet and the horizontal centre.
pixelart.alphaHint: Cut-off for semi-transparent pixels. Sharpens the edges.
pixelart.nearestHint: Best when the source is already pixel art. Leave it off for photos and illustrations.
outline.hint: Keeps the silhouette readable in dark caves.
motion.enable: Animate the walk and the attack
motion.shiftOnly: Only move the art, never reshape it
motion.hint: The walk bounces while squashing and stretching, and the attack lunges and dips. Only the walk and the attack have more than one frame, so idle and sitting stay as a single picture.
motion.mirrorSideHint: The game only has right-facing frames and mirrors them to face left, so a picture that faces left keeps facing left while walking right. This stores the side frames mirrored, making the art face the way the character travels. Leave it off for a picture that already faces right; symmetrical art is unaffected.
motion.hideBackFace: Hide the face on back-facing frames
motion.hideBackFaceHint: One picture goes into all 39 frames, so by default the face drawn for the front also appears on the back of the head. The game's own character has no eyes on its back-facing frames, and its hair reaches down over where the face would be. With this on, the head is filled with the hair colour on those frames only. The outline is kept, so the shape does not change.
tool.colourReplaceTip: Replaces every pixel of the clicked colour with the pen colour, whether or not they touch. Unlike the bucket this reaches separated areas, which is what recolouring a shirt needs.
editor.mirrorDrawingTip: Also draws each pixel on the other side of the frame. The character faces the viewer and is symmetric, so an eye, a shoulder or a boot need only be drawn once.
editor.paletteTip: The colours the sheet uses now. Click one to make it the pen colour.
editor.allFramesTip: Keep this on when working from a single picture: each stroke is applied to every frame and direction at once.
preview.title: Motion preview
preview.staticNote: Every frame holds the same picture, so playback shows no movement. Turn on "Animate the walk and the attack" under Motion on the left. "Idle", "Wind-up / aim", "Drive / fish" and "Sit" have only one frame in the game, so they never move.
preview.fpsHint: Playback speed in frames per second. In-game speed varies, so treat this as a rough guide.
preview.note: There are no dedicated frames for facing left; the game mirrors the right-facing frames. Asymmetric art such as text or logos will appear reversed when walking left. Select "Left (mirrored)" to see how it will actually look.
help.buttonTip: Shows how to use the app, what each control does, limitations, troubleshooting and the disclaimer.
action.installModTip: Installs the mod bundled with this app into the game. Unity and .NET are not required.

startup.gameNotFound:
Core Keeper was not found, so this application cannot start.

Check that the game is installed through Steam. If it is installed and still not found, use "Choose game folder…" to point at the installation folder, the one containing CoreKeeper.exe.
startup.gameNotFoundDetail: Steam's library list (libraryfolders.vdf) was read and every registered library was searched under steamapps\common\Core Keeper, but no CoreKeeper.exe was found.
startup.searchFailed:
Searching for Core Keeper failed, so this application cannot start.

Use "Choose game folder…" to point at the installation folder.

The Core Keeper version could not be determined.

Version this application supports: {0}

The version could not be read from the installation, so there is no way to tell whether it is the supported one. Correct behaviour cannot be guaranteed.

Press "Continue" to use it anyway.
startup.versionFailed: Checking the version failed. There is no way to tell whether this is the supported version, so correct behaviour cannot be guaranteed.
startup.disclaimer:
You use this application entirely at your own risk.

The author accepts no liability for any damage arising from the use of this application or the mod it installs. Save data can be corrupted, the game can misbehave, a game update can break things, and multiplayer sessions can be affected.

Back up any save you care about before using it.

You may use this application only if you agree to the above.
startup.disclaimerDetail:
- This is not an official Pugstorm or Core Keeper product. It is an unofficial, fan-made tool.
- Please do not contact the game's official support about it.
- It changes appearance only. It gives no advantage in play, but whether mods are allowed is up to wherever you are playing, such as the server you join.
- This notice is shown once. The same text is always available under "Disclaimer" in the help.
